description: Proposed field changes to one entity. entity "person": the signed-in person's own profile (job_role, years_experience, langs, skills, hourly_rate). entity "member" + teamKey + memberKey: a confirmed colleague on one of the person's teams (job_role, years_experience, langs, hourly_rate; skills are rated only by their owner). entity "team" + teamKey: intro, based, remote, availability, langs, shipped, hourly. entity "organisation" + organisationId: website, description of an organisation the person owns or administers (descriptive only; it verifies nothing). Skills: changes[{field:"skills", value:[{name, rating 1–10}]}] adds or re-rates (an existing name takes the new rating); removeSkills lists skill names to remove. Languages: addLangs / removeLangs take two-letter codes; alternatively a langs change carries the complete new list (not both). Scalars: changes[{field, value}]; hourly_rate is EUR/h, 10–2000; team hourly overrides the rate blended from members' rates, and null restores the blend; team size is not a field (it is the confirmed member count). Team shipped: value lists entries to add, each {title, url, desc}; existing entries are kept; removeShipped lists titles or links to remove. inferred=true marks a value derived from evidence rather than stated by the person; hourly rate, availability, languages and skill ratings are rejected when inferred. Each changed field becomes a separate card the person approves. Stores a proposal only. Nothing happens until the person confirms it on welance.com/directory; the result includes the review link.

evidence.description: Minimal supporting excerpt, no contact data.

inferred.description: true when derived from evidence rather than stated by the person or the source

sourceId.description: The sourceId read_public_url returned, when the value comes from that site.

value.description: The new value (type depends on field).

summary.description: One sentence, in the conversation language, saying what happens on confirm.
